title: Is Google Search Officially Dead?
description:
Is the OG Google search officially dead? 💀

At Google I/O, they announced that the tech giant is essentially replacing traditional search with an AI engine. It's not the most surprising move, but it has been very controversial.

By pushing AI overviews to the top of search and scraping info from blogs and videos to give you AI answers, Google is actively keeping people from clicking into organic websites that rely on that traffic to stay alive.

Not only can that jeopardize many small creators, but it also begs the question: if those creators lose their traffic and stop making content... what is the AI going to pull its answers from? 

#Ai #AInews #googleIO #gemini #contentcreation
transcript: It's starting to sound like this search engine is going to get more and more replaced by like an AI engine. So, the first thing we'll notice that it's turning into a longer prompt box instead of going to AI mode. So, you're essentially going to be in AI mode by default. So, if I do a search for something like best video games of 2026, you have your AI overview right here, but it takes up a relatively small amount of space on Google, I could click show more and sort of get directly into AI mode here. But without doing that, I have some organic rankings of people who actually wrote blog posts on the best video games of 2026 so far. These are websites that rely on people actually clicking on the link and going to their website to support their business. Now, if Google essentially scrapes the responses from all of these blog posts, puts them in an AI overview so that nobody ever ends up clicking into the blog post, that's going to mean a drastic reduction in traffic from Google to these websites.
